verdict.rationale: Warp's marketing site claims jobs that run "on a schedule or when something happens," with defaults on and the option to write your own. That is a first-party event-triggered automation capability. Documented webhooks also let external apps react to data-change events, but these are outbound notifications rather than in-product rules. Missing for 10: documentation of how users define trigger conditions and actions, the list of supported event types, AI-native rule authoring, and any hands-on or independent corroboration beyond a single marketing line.
